purpose: Locate whether the already observed uniform8192=64 difference is present around mathematical output64, without rerunning8192 or granting correctness/performance qualification.

source_reuse.method: new separately reviewed host wrapper includes original source with main renamed; runtime iterations only differ
source_reuse.SASS_gate: complete normalized target instruction stream, register/shared/local/occupancy identity equals frozen short and long baselines; exact normalization algorithm pinned at source-B

evidence_requirements.outputs: all8192 index/decimal-double/exactFP32bits per launch; poison before launch; finite float32 roundtrip, complete unique index range; no histogram-only evidence
evidence_requirements.stamp: all poisoned stamp fields overwritten, CUDA event completion and launch success, zero elapsed duration allowed, no full-SM requirement
evidence_requirements.summary: recompute finite/difference counts, min/max, all distinct-value counts and per-index adjacent-length differences; compare two chains and physical thread/fragment positions
evidence_requirements.reference: 2*iterations is mathematical descriptive reference, not relaxed tolerance or compulsory long-FP8 hardware result; ordinary exact checks remain unchanged
evidence_requirements.identity: freeze source/recursive dependencies/runner/auditor/contracts/reference, include original short and long records and their reviews; persist each source/binary/SASS/receipt
evidence_requirements.reject: CUDA errors, timeout, incomplete/NaN/Inf/poison outputs, malformed schema or identities, failed SASS/resource/snapshot gate; finite numeric differences are observations

execution.allocation: same GH200 UUID/toolchain/runtime policy as frozen original diagnosis; mismatch fails closed
execution.locks: suite/output lock and GPU UUID lock, active PID/PGID registry, confirmed cleanup
execution.resume: Only profiles with positive evidence that their target launch never started may continue after confirmed cleanup and unchanged hashes. Once a target may have started, missing/incomplete output or receipt is unknown/failed, never pending; no automatic retry. Re-execution requires a separately reviewed amendment. The lifetime total of started or possibly-started target launches is at most4; failed/interrupted launches consume the budget.

decision_rules.decision: uniform accumulation growth stops at this observed boundary; fixed32-iteration truncation and input-dependent loss remain observationally indistinguishable. Do not fit internal mantissa. Consider the separately specified same-dot/different-product control.
no boundary at32; existing8192 difference remains. Stop four-profile set and redesign a bounded length bracket from these facts, without automatic expansion.

decision_rules.observation: position/chain-dependent finite pattern or decrease/inconsistent boundary
decision_rules.decision: inspect archived inputs/index mapping/SASS/register dependencies and synchronization before changing reference or gathering performance; do not assume monotonicity.
reject diagnostic and repair identity/implementation issue first; no numerical interpretation or automatic rerun.

conditional_input_control.mechanism: one new runtime-tile diagnostic kernel shared by all input modes, same shape/chains/batch/wait/drain; no changes to frozen performance kernel
conditional_input_control.sparse: A[m,k]=1/4 iff k in{0,16}, else0; B[k,n]=1/4 for all k,n; D0; dense and sparse both have exact dot1/8 and expected2*iterations
conditional_input_control.nonuniform: exact existing seed3 logical input formula and chain initial values; only1/2 supported by existing reference, do not silently extend
conditional_input_control.bridge: dense1/64 must reproduce original source1/64 per-index before causally interpreting sparse; all modes share one binary/symbol and loop; actual SASS proof required for retained issue count, loop and waits. Original whole-function equality is not falsely claimed for the new tile-loading prologue.
conditional_input_control.mapping: persist complete logical and packed A/B plus independent CPU pack-unpack bijection and dense/sparse dot enumeration; nonuniform1/2 tests mapping/initialization on new path
conditional_input_control.limits: sparse64 growth while dense64 stops weakens a data-independent32-iteration cutoff; identical stops do not distinguish dot-level rounding from cutoff. Mapping failure or bridge failure blocks inference. No exact hardware precision inferred. No automatic synchronization variant.
